title: Altair HyperMesh workflows and connector status
description: Explore Altair HyperMesh workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

Siemens

Altair HyperMesh

Altair HyperMesh supports high-fidelity meshing, model assembly and simulation preprocessing.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Clean simulation geometry

Start from the idealised geometry, material assumptions and analysis scope. In the intended Altair HyperMesh preview, clean simulation geometry; the visible result is a solver-ready model view with mesh regions and constraints exposed. Review units, connectivity, mesh suitability and model assumptions before accepting or exporting it.

Create a controlled mesh

Begin with the selected load cases, contacts and solution controls. In the intended Altair HyperMesh preview, create a controlled mesh; the visible result is a configured analysis state with loads and boundary conditions visible. Review load paths, restraints, convergence controls and applicable codes before accepting or exporting it.

Export and review a solver deck

Use the completed result set and acceptance quantities. In the intended Altair HyperMesh preview, export and review a solver deck; the visible result is plots or tables that connect response values to the model. Review convergence, sensitivity, units and engineering reasonableness before accepting or exporting it.
